mapper.sql: ap.setting_id as "settingId", ap.evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", ap.college_organization_code as "collegeOrganizationCode", ap.department_organization_code as "departmentOrganizationCode", ap.appeal_start_at as "appealStartAt", ap.appeal_end_at as "appealEndAt", ap.handler_user_id as "handlerUserId", ap.active_yn as "activeYn", ap.created_by as "createdBy", ap.updated_by as "updatedBy", ap.created_at as "createdAt", ap.updated_at as "updatedAt", ap.change_reason as "changeReason"

where.if: and (ap.evaluation_year ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ap.college_organization_code ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ap.department_organization_code ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%'))

and exists ( select 1 from evaluation_organization_mappings eom where eom.user_id = #{criteria.requesterUserId} and eom.organization_code in (ap.college_organization_code, ap.department_organization_code) and eom.business_type = 'FACULTY_ACHIEVEMENT' and eom.data_scope in ('DEPARTMENT','COLLEGE','BUSINESS','ALL') )

mapper.select:
select from appeal_period_settings ap
order by ap.evaluation_year desc, ap.college_organization_code, ap.department_organization_code, ap.appeal_start_at desc limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.offset}

insert into appeal_period_settings (evaluation_year, college_organization_code, department_organization_code, appeal_start_at, appeal_end_at, handler_user_id, active_yn, change_reason, created_by, updated_by) values (#{request.evaluationYear}, #{request.collegeOrganizationCode}, #{request.departmentOrganizationCode}, #{request.appealStartAt}, #{request.appealEndAt}, #{request.handlerUserId}, #{request.activeYn}, #{request.changeReason}, #{userId}, #{userId}) returning setting_id as "settingId", evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", college_organization_code as "collegeOrganizationCode", department_organization_code as "departmentOrganizationCode", appeal_start_at as "appealStartAt", appeal_end_at as "appealEndAt", handler_user_id as "handlerUserId", active_yn as "activeYn", created_by as "createdBy", updated_by as "updatedBy", created_at as "createdAt", updated_at as "updatedAt", change_reason as "changeReason"

update appeal_period_settings set evaluation_year = #{request.evaluationYear}, college_organization_code = #{request.collegeOrganizationCode}, department_organization_code = #{request.departmentOrganizationCode}, appeal_start_at = #{request.appealStartAt}, appeal_end_at = #{request.appealEndAt}, handler_user_id = #{request.handlerUserId}, active_yn = #{request.activeYn}, change_reason = #{request.changeReason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{userId} where setting_id = #{request.settingId} returning setting_id as "settingId", evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", college_organization_code as "collegeOrganizationCode", department_organization_code as "departmentOrganizationCode", appeal_start_at as "appealStartAt", appeal_end_at as "appealEndAt", handler_user_id as "handlerUserId", active_yn as "activeYn", created_by as "createdBy", updated_by as "updatedBy", created_at as "createdAt", updated_at as "updatedAt", change_reason as "changeReason"

select count(*) from users u join user_roles ur on ur.user_id = u.user_id left join organization_user_mappings oum on oum.user_id = u.user_id and oum.status = 'ACTIVE' and oum.mapping_type in ('ORGANIZATION','POSITION') where u.user_id = #{handlerUserId} and u.status = 'ACTIVE' and u.system_use_yn = 'Y' and ur.status = 'ACTIVE' and ur.role_code in ('R04','R09') and (oum.organization_code in (#{collegeOrganizationCode}, #{departmentOrganizationCode}) or ur.role_code = 'R09')
